tabs.tab_title: What makes you different from a traditional SEO consultant?
tabs.tab_content: I combine Technical SEO, Semantic SEO, AEO, GEO and Digital PR to improve visibility across both traditional search engines and AI-powered search platforms — not just keyword rankings.

tabs.tab_title: How does SEO differ from AEO and GEO?
tabs.tab_content: SEO improves rankings within search results. AEO helps content appear in featured snippets and AI summaries. GEO increases visibility and citations inside AI-generated responses from platforms like ChatGPT and Perplexity.

tabs.tab_title: Can my business appear in Google AI Overviews?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. Businesses can increase their chances with authoritative content, structured data, entity recognition and demonstrated expertise within their industry.

tabs.tab_title: What is Entity SEO and why does it matter?
tabs.tab_content: Entity SEO helps search engines understand real-world entities and their relationships. Modern search and AI systems rely on entities for context, strengthening your presence in the Knowledge Graph.

tabs.tab_title: How long does it take to see results?
tabs.tab_content: SEO is a long-term investment. Most businesses see measurable improvements within three to six months, though competitive industries may need more time.

tabs.tab_title: What industries do you specialize in?
tabs.tab_content: I’ve worked across more than 70 industries — restaurants, SaaS, e-commerce, healthcare, real estate and professional services — each with a tailored strategy.
